pages.description: A dim twilight desert landscape under a gradient sky that shades from dark blue at the top to lighter teal near the horizon. In the mid-ground are rugged rocky boulder formations and a range of mountains, with faint reddish-brown light illuminating the upper mountain slopes. The foreground is flat scrubland dotted with low desert brush and a faint dirt path curving through it. On the left, a dark silhouetted SUV or crossover vehicle is parked, seen in profile, with visible wheels, windows, and side mirror. A single human figure stands in silhouette near the center of the frame, facing away toward the mountains. In the sky above the mountains hovers a small cluster of three glowing red-orange lights arranged in a triangular grouping.
